name: agent-cowork
description: WHAT THIS FILE IS FOR: root of repo 1 (Agent Cowork, Cal Hacks 13.0). Holds the npm workspaces (hooks, mcp, watcher, ui) and the team scripts. `npm run setup` installs every dependency at its current version, so no versions are hard-coded here. See plan.md and structure.md.

scripts.setup: npm install -D tsx typescript @types/node && npm install -w mcp @modelcontextprotocol/sdk zod@3 spacetimedb && npm install -w watcher spacetimedb @factory/droid-sdk @anthropic-ai/sdk zod@3 madge && npm install -w ui react react-dom spacetimedb && npm install -w ui -D vite @vitejs/plugin-react @types/react @types/react-dom && npm install --prefix module spacetimedb && npm install --prefix demo-app -D typescript vitest
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p hooks && tsc -p mcp && tsc -p watcher && tsc -p ui
